question: Kalamandalam Kshemavathy Pavithran was conferred the Padma Shri award for her contribution to which of the following dance forms?
solution:
Correct answer is __**Mohiniyattam. **__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Kalamandalam Kshemavathy Pavithran

 
 
• **Kalamandalam Kshemavathy Pavithran** was awarded the Padma Shri in 2011 for her contributions to **Mohinyattam.**
 
• She has also achieve the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award, and Nrithya Natya Puraskara.**
 
• Kshemavathy is famous for her **abhinaya and traditionalist approach** to the art form.
 
• She has done a **lot of innovative choreographies.**
